history.summary: UNCERTAIN IDENTITY FLAG: No authoritative source documents a shrine exactly named 'Kali Temple' in Sonamura town - this entry is a provisional placeholder. A Tripura news report places a 'Kali Temple' on the road from Sonamura College Road to Madhuban; OpenStreetMap lists a 'Shyamamayee Kali Mandir' near Kabi Nazrul Mahavidyalaya, Sonamura (23.49045, 91.27965); and a 'Shree Shree Kalitola Kali Mandir, Sonamura' page exists but its text is contradictory (claims a Bangladesh location) and unreliable. None is verified as the CSV row's referent - do NOT conflate with the Kasba/Kamalasagar Kali Temple. Coordinates below are for Sonamura town, not the shrine. History, festivals, opening hours and image are all unverified - keep-or-verify decision needed.

name: Kali Temple
town: Sonamura (CSV state column 'Sonamura' is WRONG - the state is Tripura; the shrine itself is identity-unverified, see history.summary)
town_description: Sonamura is a border town in Sipahijala district, western Tripura, on the banks of the Gomati river near the Bangladesh border. It is the headquarters of Sonamura subdivision, with Melaghar and the Neermahal palace nearby, and serves as the gateway town for the Boxanagar Buddhist site.
